does_not_cover: No standardization is ever computed and no table lookup is worked; tables/software are only name-checked at the close.
No CLT, no likelihood, no worked probability calculation; a definitions-only piece that never solves anything.
notes: Slow, clean pacing with height example; flags that the second normal parameter may denote variance or sd by source. Thin by design at 5 minutes.

segments.topic: Normal as continuous distribution with density height f(x)
Parameters mu and sigma; mean as center and median
Empirical rules: about 68, 95, 99.7 percent within 1-3 sd
Sigma as spread and the N(mu, sigma-squared) notation
Standard normal Z and probabilities as areas, done by software

suggested_locator: 01:44-02:43 for the empirical rules; 04:09-05:20 for the standard normal

teaches.why: Defines the normal family, its parameters, symmetry, and spread effects with plots.
Defines the standard normal and area-as-probability, but works no standardization.
